Tablet 100% Charged vs Leo's Brain Battery at 5%! — Your tablet hit 100% charge overnight—so why is your brain waking up stuck at 10%?
Kids science answer for "screen time before bed brain for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Bright screens near bedtime trick your brain into thinking it is daytime, delaying sleep hormones that recharge energy and memory.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
